rows.text: The ordinary height limit is 4 metres, not 5.30. Under certain conditions, variable-height vehicles carrying live animals may reach 4.30 metres without exceptional transport authorization.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-61/ art. 61, comma 1, lettera b: altezza ordinaria 4 m
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, commi 3 lettera g e 6 lettera b: deroga condizionata a 4,30 m

rows.text: The ordinary height limit, including the load, is 4 metres. Under certain conditions, vehicles carrying hay bales or rolls may reach 4.30 metres without exceptional transport authorization; 5.30 metres is not the ordinary limit.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-61/ art. 61, comma 1, lettera b: 4 m carico compreso
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, commi 3 lettera g-bis e 6 lettera b: deroga condizionata a 4,30 m

rows.text: Work machines on roads normally have a 4-metre height limit. If functional needs make them exceed it, they are exceptional and subject to the relevant rules; 5.30 metres is not the ordinary limit.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-114/ art. 114, commi 1 e 3: limiti ordinari e macchine eccezionali
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-61/ art. 61, comma 1 lettera b: altezza 4 m

rows.text: ATP vehicles may be up to 2.60 metres wide. The general 2.55-metre limit is not the maximum for this category.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-61/ art. 61, commi 1 lettera a e 4: 2,55 m generale e 2,60 m ATP

rows.text: The ordinary height limit, including the load, is 4 metres. Certain intermodal container transports may, subject to conditions, reach 4.30 metres without exceptional authorization; 4.70 metres is not the ordinary limit.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-61/ art. 61, comma 1 lettera b: altezza ordinaria 4 m
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, commi 3 lettera e e 6 lettera b-bis: deroga condizionata 4,30 m

rows.text: The ordinary limit on the most heavily loaded axle is 12 tonnes regardless of vehicle type; construction vehicles have different limits and specific conditions.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-62/ art. 62, comma 5: limite ordinario di 12 t
https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8: mezzi d’opera fino a 13 t per asse

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE, but includes a boundary that differs from the law: the 12-tonne limit for two adjacent axles applies when their spacing is less than 1 m. At exactly 1 m the general axle-group ceiling is 16 tonnes; lower vehicle or document limits may still apply.
evidence: Supplied official superiori question 28505 prints VERO and says spacing “non superiore a 1 metro”, including exactly 1 m.
Codice della strada art. 62(6), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-62/ : 12 t for spacing strictly under 1 m; 16 t for 1 m or more and under 1.3 m, subject to applicable lower vehicle limits.
2023 source-era code, https://www.polizialocalebg.it/images/news/CODICE-DELLA-STRADA-AGGIORNATO-MARZO-2023.pdf art. 62(6): same boundary; compiler is retired Bergamo local-police officer.

rows.text: The ordinary legal limit on the most heavily loaded axle is 12 tonnes regardless of vehicle type; the rule does not set it according to the number of wheels on the axle.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-62/ art. 62, comma 5: 12 t qualunque sia il tipo di veicolo

rows.text: The ordinary limit on the most heavily loaded axle is 12 tonnes; 14 is not the limit specified by the rule.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-62/ art. 62, comma 5: limite ordinario 12 t per asse

rows.text: The special total mass limits for construction vehicles apply provided the most heavily loaded axle does not exceed 13 tonnes; the applicable circulation conditions must also be met.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, commi 7 e 8: condizioni e massimo 13 t sull’asse

rows.text: For a standalone two-axle motor construction vehicle, the special laden mass limit is 20 tonnes, with no more than 13 tonnes on the most heavily loaded axle.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8 lettera a: due assi 20 t e asse massimo 13 t

rows.text: For a standalone three-axle motor construction vehicle, the special laden mass limit is 33 tonnes, with no more than 13 tonnes on the most heavily loaded axle.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8 lettera a: tre assi 33 t e asse massimo 13 t

rows.text: The special limit is 40 tonnes for a standalone construction vehicle with at least four axles and two front steering axles, provided the most heavily loaded axle does not exceed 13 tonnes.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8 lettera a: 40 t e limite asse 13 t

rows.text: For a four-axle construction vehicle combination, the special laden mass limit is 44 tonnes, with no more than 13 tonnes on the most heavily loaded axle.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8 lettera b: quattro assi 44 t e asse massimo 13 t

rows.text: For a construction vehicle combination with at least five axles, the general special limit is 56 tonnes, with no more than 13 tonnes on the most heavily loaded axle; a specific limit applies to concrete mixers.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8 lettera b: 56 t, betoniera 54 t e asse massimo 13 t

rows.text: For a construction vehicle combination with at least five axles carrying concrete in a mixer, the special limit is 54 tonnes, with no more than 13 tonnes on the most heavily loaded axle.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8 lettera b: betoniera 54 t e asse massimo 13 t

rows.text: For a construction vehicle the special limit on the most heavily loaded axle is 13 tonnes, not 18.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 8: asse massimo 13 t

rows.text: The special limit for a standalone two-axle motor construction vehicle is 20 tonnes, not 24, with no more than 13 tonnes on the most heavily loaded axle.

rows.text: A vehicle is exceptional when its running configuration exceeds ordinary dimension or mass limits for specific functional needs. This characteristic concerns the vehicle itself.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 1: definizione di veicolo eccezionale

rows.text: A load can make transport exceptional even if the vehicle alone is within the limits: for example, an indivisible item can make it exceed the permitted dimensions. Other forms of exceptional transport also exist.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-10/ art. 10, comma 2 lettera a e comma 3: carico indivisibile e altre fattispecie; si interpreta la frase come esempio, non definizione esclusiva
